title: ODYSSEY - Going Back to My Roots (Single Version) - 1981

lines.l: To the pace of my bed
I've been standing in the rain
And being exposed to real men
I'm home and found, got my head turned around
Going back to my roots, yeah
To the place of my birth
Ain't talking about the roots in the land
Talking about the roots in the man
I feel my spirits getting old
It's time to recharge my soul
Sipping up the boots, going back to my roots, yeah
